root_cause: GitHub ubuntu-latest advanced to ubuntu26.04-x64, but the pinned Playwright 1.55.0 Chromium installer explicitly rejects that OS. Previously live site/SEO readback passed; browser proof did not run.

failure_evidence.provider_error: Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64
failure_evidence.site_validation_prior_to_failure: live canonical shell + SEO order readback succeeded

remedy.change: Pin production-readback job to ubuntu-24.04, leave real-browser proof fail-closed and unskipped.
remedy.prevention: Whenever a Playwright version is pinned, production browser proof runs on a separately pinned Playwright-supported runner OS. Never promote page acceptance on HTTP/readback alone when actual visual proof is required.

release_required: Real browser install and visible-page render on deployed production SHA
